name: Whisperwind Grove
summary: Whisperwind Grove is a quiet sanctuary located in central Felwood, just south of Irontree Woods. Maintained by the Emerald Circle, an autonomous branch of the Cenarion Circle, it is renowned as a rare pocket of healed land amidst the surrounding taint. Most notably, the grove shelters the only uncorrupted moonwell remaining in the entire corrupted forest.

sections.title: A Bastion of Pure Water
sections.body: While the demonic corruption of the Third War withered the vast majority of Felwood into a blighted mire of toxic pools and twisted trees, Whisperwind Grove stands as a stubborn miracle. Maintained by druids and wardens of the Emerald Circle—an autonomous sect working under the broader umbrella of the Cenarion Circle—the immediate clearing has been painstakingly purged of demonic rot. Its crown jewel is its pristine moonwell, brimming with sacred water completely untainted by the fel seepage that has ruined every other shrine in the region.

faq.answer: Whisperwind Grove is an outpost established by the Emerald Circle, a branch of the Cenarion Circle. Situated in the heart of Felwood, it serves as an uncorrupted sanctuary dedicated to restoring and studying the ravaged woodlands.

faq.q: Why is the moonwell here significant?
faq.answer: Nearly every natural spring and sacred moonwell throughout Felwood was thoroughly poisoned by demonic filth following the Third War. The moonwell at Whisperwind Grove is famous for being the only one in the entire zone that has been completely cleansed and preserved.

The Emerald Circle is a largely autonomous branch of the Cenarion Circle. While aligned with the greater goals of the druids in Kalimdor, they focus heavily on regional purification efforts in heavily blighted sectors like Felwood.

faq.q: Is Whisperwind Grove safe for both Alliance and Horde?
faq.answer: Yes. As a sanctuary maintained under the auspices of Cenarion druids, the grove remains dedicated to nature's healing rather than factional war, welcoming both Alliance and Horde travelers.

angles.text: For druids fighting to reclaim Felwood, the grove proves that even the deepest demonic taint can be overcome through sacred waters and dedication.
Finding a clean moonwell amidst the ruin of Felwood offers a rare moment of solace and spiritual connection to Elune in an otherwise dying land.
